versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Work Productivity Skillscan Security Workflow Helper.
- Provides validated SkillScan-style workflows and checklists for productivity, security, and reliability improvements.
- Includes a step-by-step framework for requirements assessment, work planning, and artifact delivery.
- Designed for easy adaptation to local hardware, favoring scripts, templates, and CPU-safe workflows.
- Built-in triggers and usage guidance for a broad range of skill and workflow requests.
